claims.claim: In all but name a two-voice fugue; entries in i, v, III, bVII, iv.
Two almost equal sections bounded by perfect cadences in v (bar 12) and i (bar 24).
Ten of the fourteen entries differ slightly from bars 1-2.
One bar of common time treated as two bars of 2/4; the third beat can be as strong as the first.
Ten of 24 bars not directly concerned with subject/answer; episodes bind rather than separate.
Imperfect cadence in bar 19 marks end of development; bar 21 a phrase extension; bar 24 miniature coda.
